data.desc: Dot Ai (Nasdaq: DAIC) is an ambient IoT and asset-intelligence company. Its Industrial Bridge reader and patent-pending on-metal and wet-environment antenna technology make battery-free ambient tags readable in industrial and outdoor conditions, and its U.S. Patent No. 11,017,189 covers the vehicle-as-reader architecture in which a moving reader dynamically tracks moving beacons. Dot Ai serves an industrial partner ecosystem.
